FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 6th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that the bell will ring at 11:15 a.m. on 07-08-2026 (Friday) in view of the Full
Court reference on the demise of Laimayum Sharat Sharma, Advocate.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ !} {t C –'28
